rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for plotting a route or giving route guidance to someone driving.

example.english: I’m driving to the New Territories; help me navigate.
example.traditional: 我開車去新界，你幫我導航吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 ce1 heoi3 san1 gaai3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 dou6 hong4 haa5

rows.note: Use this for moving through webpages, menus, or other parts of a website.

example.english: I usually navigate the website’s menu first, then click into the page I want to read.
example.traditional: 我通常先瀏覽網站嘅目錄，再撳入想睇嘅頁面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 sin1 lau4 laam5 mong5 zaam6 ge3 muk6 luk6 zoi3 gam6 jap6 soeng2 tai2 ge3 jip6 min6

rows.note: Use this for coping with or working through a difficult situation or process rather than for physical travel.

example.english: Faced with so many unexpected problems, I don’t know how to navigate them.
example.traditional: 面對咁多突發問題，我都唔知點樣應付。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 dat6 faat3 man6 tai4 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng2 jing3 fu6
